notes: Coordinates are transcribed from the cited official AIP pages and are not inferred from chart appearance.
Exact published coordinates are not equivalent to a verified map transform; feature-to-PDF matching and independent checks are still required.
OIMM Jeppesen page 603 prints stand coordinates at only 0.1 minute of arc (~185m north/south); such coordinates are NOT accepted as parking-stand-level controls.
OIMM official APDC, effective 2026-10-01, states INFO not AVBL for stand coordinate entries. Do not fabricate replacements.
Source release validity must be checked for the active AIRAC cycle before use.
